name: application-phone-number-input
title: Phone Number Input
description: A country-code selector (flag + dial code) fused to a national number field, with an optional open dropdown for choosing the country.
useWhen: Collecting a phone number where the country/dial code needs to be explicit and user-selectable, not assumed.
SMS verification, contact forms, or account settings that store an international-format phone number.
avoidWhen: You only ever collect numbers from a single fixed country — a plain `Input` with a format hint is simpler.
You need full IMEI-style validation or formatting-as-you-type logic — this component provides the visual shell; wire real formatting/validation in your app code.
responsiveBehavior: The country selector keeps a fixed intrinsic width based on its flag+code content while the number field grows to fill the remaining space.
accessibility: The country trigger button uses aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded to describe its popup relationship.
The open dropdown uses role="listbox"/role="option" with aria-selected marking the current country, plus a visible checkmark so the state isn't color-only.
The number field keeps a real <label> associated via htmlFor/id, and type="tel" hints the correct mobile keyboard.

variants.title: Closed selector
variants.description: A US (+1) country selector fused to a formatted national number field, with helper text below.
accessibility: The number input has a real label and type="tel" for correct mobile keyboard behavior.

variants.title: Closed selector (Dark)
variants.description: Closed country selector and number field adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Border, background, and text colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark form surfaces.

variants.title: Open country dropdown
variants.description: The country selector open, showing a searchable list of countries with the current selection checked (United Kingdom, +44).
accessibility: The selected option carries aria-selected="true" and a visible checkmark, not color alone.

variants.title: Open country dropdown (Dark)
variants.description: Open country dropdown adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The selected row's highlight and checkmark both meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark dropdown background.
